heading: Motherboard
bottomHtml:
High-Performance Motherboard – Ultimate Foundation for Gaming & Productivity PCs

Unlock the full potential of your build with this high-performance motherboard, designed for gamer, creators, and power users. This motherboard is engineered to support the latest Intel/AMD processors and delivers exceptional speed, stability, and connectivity. Featuring support for DDR4/DDR5 RAM, PCIe 4.0/5.0 slots, M.2 NVMe SSDs, and USB 3.2/Type-C interfaces, it ensures lightning-fast performance and future-ready expansion.

Socket compatibility with the latest Intel/AMD CPU, Supports up to 128GB DDR4/DDR5 RAM, Multiple PCIe slots for GPUs and expansion cards, Dual/Triple M.2 NVMe SSD slots for ultra-fast storage, Integrated Wi-Fi 6 / Bluetooth 5.2 / Gigabit LAN, Advanced thermal design for optimal cooling, Customizable RGB lighting and fan controls, Designed for gaming, streaming, content creation, and professional workloads.
